name: Elders And Deacons
overview: Scripture reveals that elders and deacons serve distinct but complementary roles within the church, with elders appointed to oversee and shepherd the flock by the Holy Spirit (Acts 20:28; Acts 14:23), while deacons are chosen for practical service, ensuring the needs of the congregation are met with wisdom and integrity (Acts 6:1,3). These leaders are to be men of good reputation, filled with the Holy Spirit, and committed to godliness and truth (Acts 6:3; Titus 1:1). Their ministry includes both nurturing the spiritual health of the church and confronting unfruitful works of darkness through faithful reproof (Ephesians 5:11).
